scientific_integrity: Theorem is an integral homotopy classification. Complete signed face-poset matching and integer Morse differentials were computed from the stated graph and checked by an independent Kneser-model mod-two homology calculation. Mod-two ranks are corroboration only; integral primitivity uses exact signed matrices and a unit minor.
scientific_limitations: Only the Petersen graph and its complete sequence of integer matching-number thresholds are classified. The computation is exact and reproducible but does not establish a general cubic-graph theorem or an equivariant splitting. A potentially equivalent unindexed result could exist; independent mathematical review has not been performed.
title: Complete matching-number homotopy filtration of the Petersen graph
